postal_system.assignment_rule: Correo Uruguayo defines a five-digit postal code whose digits support postal routing and whose complete value identifies a delivery point or a set of delivery points. Current interactive or web-service observations and the separately released August 2023 bulk artifacts are time-dependent evidence. A valid text pattern alone is not an assignment, geometry, address, building, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Correo Uruguayo publishes official postal-code SHP and KML resources under the Uruguay open-data licence; the August 2023 SHP resource declares EPSG:4326. An exact resource-pinned feature may be stored as official release geometry with source UUID, digest, validity and supersession. A catalog page, code string, live lookup, IDE address point, administrative boundary, DNC parcel, OSM feature, interpolation, Voronoi, buffer, API cache or model surface cannot be substituted for that release geometry or used to fill unknown current coverage.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building, street or road, door number, block, lot, floor, unit, P.O. Box, neighborhood or place, locality, municipality, department and five-digit postcode as separate fields. Formatting guidance and synthetic fixtures contain no real example address, person, property or upstream response.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as postal_area, delivery_point, delivery_point_set, route, po_box, organization, other_special or unknown. A released Polygon or MultiPolygon is area geometry for that source release; the same five-digit syntax does not prove that every assignment is areal or that every API result has a matching release feature.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared SuDir or civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. A postal polygon, postcode, Correo or IDE address point, DNC parcel, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: Dirección Nacional de Catastro publishes monthly urban and rural parcel shapes and related cadastral context under the Uruguay open-data licence. Parcels remain separate from postal areas, civic addresses and buildings. Padron, owner, occupant, value, tax, unit and improvement attributes require exact field-level authority, privacy review and explicit stable relations before any public use.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted Correo and IDE calls, mathematical models and machine learning may normalize input, compare an address point with a release polygon, compress indexed geometry, detect drift and produce review candidates. Every output preserves source/resource UUID, release and model version, request and input digests, observed_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and official or derived status. It never overwrites the official release, invents current coverage, or infers a door number, block, lot, unit, building or occupant.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate release-pinned postal polygons, typed postal objects, permitted civic-address points, explicit address-building relations and administrative or cadastral context to AGID cells without relabelling any source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official Correo geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The postal polygon, IDE address and DNC parcel catalog resources declare the Licencia de Datos Abiertos de Uruguay, which requires a note of origin naming the provider, the licence and the dataset, plus disclosure of modifications. Pin the exact resource UUID and licence text for every release. Correo web-service observations require separate terms and retention review; ODbL data stays partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO UY scope. It does not silently extend a postal release beyond its declared land coverage into maritime space, unrepresented offshore areas, international-boundary assertions or any separately sourced territorial claim. Store source coverage, asserted_by, legal status, boundary vintage and AGID jurisdiction independently.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact addresses, door numbers, blocks, lots, coordinates, entrances, floors, units, recipients, owners, occupants, padrón and tax records, API responses, credentials and query logs can expose personal, property or security context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postal assignments and geometries, web-service observations, IDE address identities and points, administrative names and boundaries, DNC parcels, building geometries, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, resource UUID, source release, digest and supersession independently; never rewrite historical evidence or present the August 2023 polygon as timeless current truth.

stages.definition: A complete current ordinary Correo Uruguayo assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and explicit non-area denominator is fixed with compatible rights; every eligible exact Polygon/MultiPolygon is source- and release-pinned, validates and loads through the API/app, exposes stable postal, official cp_id, geometry, assertion, release and AGID reference IDs, renders and fits as a translucent area, and clears/re-searches without publishing reserved CPA, fabricating missing areas or inferring addresses, buildings, parcels, people or land rights.
